retrieval.method: GitHub release API and release asset download; case-insensitive archive search

rights.terms: Metadata-only inspection of the public immutable release; source-specific dataset terms remain attached and no payload is copied downstream.
rights.permitted_destination: negative receipt, release identity, hashes, and candidate-only terminology finding

search_result.acoramidis_or_tafamidis_matches: terminology and non-UK schedule concepts only

disposition.rationale: The release contains RxNorm terminology rows for acoramidis and tafamidis and an Australian PBS tafamidis schedule row, but no TA1121 record, UK approved-derived n/m/d packet, NHS displaced programme, baseline unit, aligned uncertainty, or approval receipt.
disposition.contingency: Retain released terminology only as discovery metadata and keep empirical calibration disabled.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Retry only against a newer immutable Atlas release or an issue-attached approved-derived packet; invalidate downstream review if the exact release, packet, or terms change.
